title: AI Solutions Architect | Enterprise Architecture
summary: AI solutions architect and consultancy founder connecting business priorities with production AI systems. Led delivery of 120+ GenAI applications and 90+ AI chatbots for 30+ clients, serving as principal architect across engagements. At Assent, deployed a governed multi-model stack and delivered $1.7M+ in operational savings while increasing internal AI adoption from 47% to 97%. Combines hands-on architecture, enterprise platform experience, stakeholder coordination, and practical AI education.
